description: An implementation of a voice assistant bot using Pipecat framework, integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech, language models, and service switching strategies. The script sets up the pipeline with various services, configures event handlers for client connection/disconnection, and defines the main execution flow.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Defines the schema for a function callable within the LLM pipeline, including name, description, properties, and required fields.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Holds the schema for standard tools and functions available to the LLM.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turns locally for improved turn management.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer using the Silero model.

classes.name: VADParams
classes.description: Parameters configuration for voice activity detection.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Frame representing an LLM run in the pipeline.

classes.name: ManuallySwitchServiceFrame
classes.description: Frame used to manually switch audio or LLM services during runtime.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the sequence of processing steps in the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with specific parameters and execution control.

classes.name: RunnerArguments
classes.description: Arguments for runner configuration and behavior.

classes.name: ServiceSwitcher
classes.description: Handles switching between different audio or service providers based on strategy.

classes.name: LLMSwitcher
classes.description: Specialized switcher for language model providers with function registration capabilities.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Context object for LLM interactions, including messages and tools.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Aggregates LLM context with user-specific parameters for advanced management.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, including starting and cancellation.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches weather data and passes it to the callback.

methods.name: get_restaurant_recommendation(params: FunctionCallParams, location: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously provides a restaurant recommendation, demonstrating function call handling.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up and runs the full bot pipeline with all configured services and event handlers.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point; initializes transport and starts the bot pipeline.
